fills.name: Three Loch Lookout
fills.quote: The number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%.
fills.tieReason: The tooltip at s_02307 reads clearly: 'Has a large line of sight and adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout. The number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%.' Both numbers are on screen. 75 fits this field because data/upcoming-civs/checklist.json already records Three Loch Lookout effectValue=75 as confirmed, backed by two independent transcripts (c_oaynL66jY 38:20 and wzT5WTqIIU4 18:15), both about the +75% warriors per muster. The 3 extra muster charges is a second effect and belongs in effectText, not effectValue.
